articles.summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (InvenTrust, IVT, or the Company) today announced the acquisition of Sandy Plains Centre, a 124,000 square foot center anchored by Kroger Co. and Pets Supply Plus in Marietta, Georgia, for $44.2 million. This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20181226005128/en/ (Photo: Business Wire) Through this transaction, we expand our existing shopping center portfolio in Atlanta. This assets location in Marietta affords favorable demographics and compelling opportunities for future revenue growth, said Christopher Covey, Senior Vice President of Transactions for InvenTrust. Developed in 1997, Sandy Plains Centre boasts a stable tenant base featuring Kroger, the regions number-one grocer, as well as other nationally-recognized, fast-growing retailers and restaurants.
